title: Policy
description: Machine-readable policy document. Evaluation is deterministic: same policy + same evidence = same decision. unlimited_approval_action may be 'deny' or 'escalate' but never 'allow' (schema-enforced). Institutional extensions (roles, workflows, jurisdictions) reserved for v2.

allowed_chain_ids.description: null = evaluated, no restriction; empty array = deny all chains

contract_allowlist.description: when non-null, interactions restricted to these targets

asset_restrictions.description: when non-null, only these assets ('native' or token addresses) may move

unlimited_approval_action.description: action for unlimited ERC-20 approvals; 'allow' is intentionally not a member (CL-POL-002, AC-005)

unlimited_approval_override.description: v1.1 (AC-005 operator decision 2026-07-04): time-boxed soft override. While active (evaluated against the intent's created_at), unlimited approvals are ESCALATED instead of the default action — never silently allowed. Window bounded to 720 hours (30 days); must be refreshed after expiry. Reminders and periodic unlimited-approval summaries are consumer-UI scope; the audit log carries the data.

unknown_action_behavior.description: behavior when decoded action or simulation is unknown/failed; 'allow' intentionally impossible (CL-POL-004)

risk_escalation_at.description: risk level at/above which escalation is required; unknown/conflicting always escalate

hardware_confirmation_above_wei.description: reserved: escalate to hardware confirmation (adapter deferred)

session_time_restrictions.description: reserved for v1.x: time-of-day / expiry constraints on grants
